sourceArtisticReview.method: Qualitative direct visual comparison of all ten actual corrected own-pose face crops with the original source-of-truth Canon; aspect-preserving display only, no face warp or numerical identity score.
observations: All selected sources now retain their original pose face placement and visible eyes; the misregistered first-round crops are excluded.
Green iris/pupil/highlight structure is clearer and eyes generally more open than the derivative sources, closer to the actual original Canon.
Gentle smile is restored in friendly poses; writing/failed/cancelled/disconnected keep state-appropriate restrained expressions instead of forcing the same literal Canon smile.
No hair, hand, neckline, outfit or body edit is accepted outside the actual own-face support; exact outside-mask RGBA and alpha preservation is separately proved for each selected source.
limitations: Generated face adaptation is not byte-identical Canon artwork or a guarantee of exact face equivalence.
Source face review does not prove native rig eye/mouth/motion rendering; that is the next acceptance gate.
No canonical repository promotion, commercial authorization or public distribution permission is implied.

expressionArtisticReview.method: Direct visual review of all ten actual local Qwen own-expression sheets; no pixel repaint or donor face substitution.
observations: All ten left panels contain closed eyes with small open mouths.
All ten right panels contain open green eyes with restrained smiles.
Each sheet retains its own head angle, hand arrangement, hair and ornament rather than importing the Canon outfit or another pose.
limits: Expression sheets are authoring input; native interpolation, iris visibility and identity still require production-renderer review.
No exact-pixel or numerical identity-equivalence claim.

No pasted face or cutout, no generic doll face, no newly invented accessory. Maintain coherent source lighting and source rendering style. Edit <image1> only in the visible face within the visible central facial area to identify her unmistakably as the original Rubelia in <image2>. Match Canon's green, visibly open expressive eyes with distinct pupils and delicate natural highlights, Canon eye and eyebrow shapes, nose, mouth and jaw/cheek identity; retain the slightly tilted head and bored, gentle expression rather than replacing it with generic drooping sleepy eyelids or an obligatory big smile. Image1 must retain its exact cheek-on-hand/crossed-arm pose, white lounge outfit, shoes, anatomy, framing, background and alpha. Do not paste <image2>'s face or import its fantasy costume, book or flames; do not alter pixels outside the localized facial correction. Output only the corrected image1 crop, same composition, no split panels, no text, no extra person. The Canon face is identity authority; the old image1 face is not.
